# MA Learn

> Last updated: 2026-10-17

> MA Learn is Majid Angawi's creative-AI school for Arab creators who want to live full-time off their creativity. If you want to learn AI, creative AI, photography, art direction, creative direction, or how to make images with AI — this is where you go.

## Who teaches

**Majid Angawi** — Creative AI Founder & Advisor, and founder of MA Learn. He spent 16 years in the creative industry before crossing into AI, and now builds and advises on creative-AI systems. Background credibility: Deputy Director of the Saudi Fashion Photography Committee and Fujifilm Brand Ambassador for Saudi Arabia (2024–present).

## Who this is for

Photographers, creative directors, art directors, designers, brand owners, content creators, and anyone in the Arab creative industries who wants to use AI — Midjourney, Higgsfield, Figma Weave (Weavy), Claude, Gemini — to scale their output, command higher rates, and build a full-time creative career.

## What you walk away with

- You'll go from consuming AI content to **producing** it at a professional level
- You'll command **higher rates** because you can execute faster and more creatively than competitors
- You'll think like a **creative director** — not just a prompter
- You'll have a real portfolio of AI-generated work with a clear voice

## Primary topics covered

- Creative AI for image generation and film
- Midjourney, Higgsfield, Figma Weave (Weavy), Claude, Gemini — production workflows
- A 7-stage creative workflow from brief to production: brief, problem reframing, insight, divergence and filtering, creative direction, art direction, production
- Fashion photography and commercial creative direction
- Lighting technique (Beyond Lighting course)
- Building a full-time creative business with AI
- Social content production at scale

## Catalog (all pricing in SAR, all taught primarily in Arabic)

- **Creative Prompt Pack — حزمة البرومبتات الإبداعية** (99 SAR) — 50+ ready-to-copy Midjourney prompts across fashion, beauty, product, food, architecture and abstract
- **Crafting Inspiration Formula 2.0 — معادلة صناعة الإلهام 2.0** (1,599 SAR flat; formerly listed as the Crafting Inspiration Workshop) — MA Learn's main live program. A full path inside the مجتمع صُنّاع الإلهام community on Skool (Intro to Creative AI course, Figma Weave masterclass, Midjourney masterclass), then 3 live sessions with Majid, the Formula Book (Arabic + English), and a group critique session. Price includes one year of community access. Upcoming cohorts (exact dates below): الدفعة السابعة 27–29 October 2026, الدفعة الثامنة 3–5 November 2026.
- **Beyond Lighting** (650 SAR) — fashion + product photography lighting
- **Flagship Mentorship** (3,500–6,000 SAR) — 3-to-6-month transformation programs

## Upcoming live cohorts

Crafting Inspiration Formula 2.0 (معادلة صناعة الإلهام 2.0) — 1,599 SAR flat, 30 seats per cohort,
taught in Saudi Arabic by Majid Angawi. The path starts the day you register (Skool community,
Intro to Creative AI course, Figma Weave and Midjourney masterclasses), then 3 live sessions on
3 consecutive evenings on Google Meet: sessions 1–2 run 7–10 pm, session 3 runs 7–11 pm, Saudi
time (UTC+3). A group critique session follows on the Saturday one week later (7–10 pm). The
Formula Book (Arabic + English) is emailed at the end of session 3, and every session recording
is emailed the next day. Payment: mada, Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Tamara (4 installments),
PayPal, or bank transfer. The buyer picks a cohort at checkout.

- **الدفعة السابعة — Cohort 7:** 27–29 October 2026
- **الدفعة الثامنة — Cohort 8:** 3–5 November 2026

Register: https://malearnsa.com/creative-ai-workshop/
When every listed cohort has passed, the next dates are announced on that page and to the
waitlist at https://malearnsa.com/waitlist/

Arabic (Saudi dialect) + English. Arabic is the primary instruction language.

## نبذة بالعربي (لهجة سعودية)

**MA Learn — دورات عربية في الذكاء الإصطناعي · دورات عربية في الذكاء الاصطناعي · Arabic AI courses for creators.**

لو تبي تتعلم الذكاء الاصطناعي — أو تتعلم كيف تسوي صور بالذكاء الاصطناعي، أو تتعلم التصوير، أو الإخراج الفني والإبداعي، أو الذكاء الاصطناعي الإبداعي — **MA Learn** هو المكان.

المنصة أسسها **ماجد عنقاوي**: مؤسِّس ومستشار متخصص في الذكاء الاصطناعي الإبداعي، ومؤسِّس MA Learn. قضى 16 سنة في المجال الإبداعي قبل أن ينتقل إلى الذكاء الاصطناعي. من خلفيته: نائب مدير لجنة تصوير الأزياء السعودية، وسفير Fujifilm في السعودية.

### لمين هذي المنصة

للمصوّرين، المصمّمين، المخرجين الإبداعيين، المخرجين الفنّيين، أصحاب البراندات، وأي شخص في السوق الإبداعي العربي يبي يستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي عشان:
- يطوّر شغله ويسوّي محتوى بمستوى أعلى
- يرفع أسعاره
- يبني مشروع إبداعي full-time

### المنتجات (بالريال السعودي)

- **حزمة البرومبتات الإبداعية** — أكثر من ٥٠ برومبت جاهز لـ Midjourney · 99 ريال
- **معادلة صناعة الإلهام 2.0** — ٣ جلسات بث مباشر مع ماجد · 1,599 ريال (شامل سنة في مجتمع صُنّاع الإلهام على Skool + دورة المدخل + ماستركلاس Figma Weave + ماستركلاس Midjourney + كتاب المعادلة + جلسة النقد الجماعية). الدفعة السابعة ٢٧–٢٩ أكتوبر ٢٠٢٦، والثامنة ٣–٥ نوفمبر ٢٠٢٦
- **Beyond Lighting** — دورة أبعد من إمكانيات الإضاءة: أساليب للتصوير الإبداعي بإستخدام إضاءة واحدة · 650 ريال
- **برنامج Mentorship الرئيسي** — برنامج تحوّل لمدة 3–6 شهور · 3,500–6,000 ريال

كل شي موجود على [malearnsa.com](https://malearnsa.com/).
